data.one_liner: Platform-agnostic rich text document model based on Delta format.
data.what_it_does: Parchment provides a rich text document model built on the Delta format, primarily used in the Fleather editor. It is a generic Dart package that handles document nodes, formatting, and codecs without depending on Flutter.
use_when: Building or extending a rich text editor like Fleather
Processing rich text documents in a platform-agnostic Dart environment
avoid_when: You only need basic plain string manipulations
You need a complete ready-to-use UI widget set outside of Fleather
strengths: Platform-agnostic and does not depend on Flutter
weaknesses: Documentation is sparse and relies on the main Fleather repository
